name: Software Architecture
summary: The high-level structure of software systems: architectural styles, quality-attribute trade-offs, documentation and evaluation of architecture decisions.

topics.name: What architecture is: structures, views and decisions
Quality attributes and trade-offs: performance, availability, modifiability and security
Architectural styles: layered, pipe-and-filter, client-server and event-driven
Monoliths, modular monoliths, service-oriented architecture and microservices
Documenting architecture: C4 model, 4+1 views and architecture decision records
Interface styles: REST, RPC, GraphQL and messaging
Data architecture: shared databases, CQRS and event sourcing
Architecture for cloud and serverless systems
The architect's role and communicating decisions
